images.alt: Gelovigen getuigen over Gajus — 3 Johannes 1:3; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. 3 John 1:3–4 recalls brothers coming to the elder and testifying that Gaius lives in the truth, bringing the elder great joy. Three adult men in a modest first-century household room, two travelling believers seated with an elderly elder, reporting warmly while he listens with quiet joy. No Gaius present being introduced, readable letter, invented visit to a named city or crowd. Simple travel bags set beside the two messengers, coherent hands and two arms each, modest opaque robes.

rows: Geliefd; leeft in waarheid en handelt trouw voor reizende gelovigen.
